messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning the social cadence for next-gen inference launch. Need to lock copy A/B, schedule windows for NA/EU/APAC, and decide what we pin as the top reply (demo clip vs. stat card).

sahil: Uploaded assets to /drive/launch-kit. Includes 15s clip, 30s cut, and stat PNGs. I'll also export 1:1 and 9:16.

maya: awesome. can you add a version with subtitle burn-in for FB/LI? many people watch without sound.

sahil: on it. will add burned captions by EOD.

ana: Posted two headline variants in the doc:
- A: "Ship features faster with predictable LLM inference"
- B: "Cut inference cost 3x while keeping latency low"
Also drafted a short threaded outline for LinkedIn (tease -> technical dive -> CTA).

maya: i like A for LinkedIn, B for X. we should run B as the experiment on X to compare CTR.

ryan: routing details: landing page /launch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch&utm_medium=x or linkedin. For demo-book flow add &intent=demo. For webinar use &utm_content=webinar.

maya: can we make the pinned top reply be the 15s demo + a one-line stat card? i want the first click to be immediate value.

ana: agree. pinned reply: short clip + stat card + "Book a 15-min walkthrough" link. i'll draft.

maya: timezone schedule proposal:
- NA: Tue 10am PT main post
- EU: Tue 2pm GMT amplifier repost with localized copy
- APAC: Wed 9am SGT boosted post (use 9:16 story clips)
Split test X headline B at NA and EU only.

ryan: will create separate campaign tags per region: region=NA/EU/APAC. Makes tracking easier.

maya: engagement: SDRs should respond to any comment within 2 hours weekdays. We'll attach two canned replies: "Thanks! Here's a quick demo" and "Want a deeper walk? Schedule here".

ryan: canned replies added to shared doc under "social-handles/replies". Also added a webhook to send fresh leads to HubSpot: payload includes name, handle, utm_campaign, region.

tabot: Reminder set: post drafts into #marketing-assets by Mon 16:00 PT for review.

ana: also creating a gated asset (one-page benchmark PDF). We'll gate it behind an email capture on the landing page and surface the PDF link in the pinned reply to a smaller audience (paid boost + targeted org lists).

maya: good. make sure the gated PDF has a small highlighted line: "Median latency: 95ms; 3x cost reduction vs baseline" so social copy and the asset align.

sahil: quick ask: for the stat overlay, what font/colors? Use brand bold, white text on navy gradient, 48px headline.

maya: yep brand bold. drop the hex in the asset doc.

ana: CRO note: For the A/B on X, we'll run headline B vs a control that keeps CTA text "Learn more" vs "Book a demo". Monitor CTR and demo bookings.

ryan: scheduled ad boost for APAC will run for 48 hours starting Wed 00:00 SGT. I'll coordinate budgets with paid team.

maya: blockers?

sahil: none. captions in progress.

ana: one more thing: can we pin a comment on LinkedIn posts clarifying pricing/offer for enterprise customers? some folks ask. i'll prepare a FAQ snippet to paste as pinned comment.

maya: yes add an "enterprise FAQ" pinned thread. SDRs can escalate any enterprise signals to sales@redwood.com.

ryan: tagging final checklist: assets uploaded, UTM ready, webhook configured, canned replies done, schedule created in calendar.

maya: perfect. will do final tone pass Mon AM and then approve drafts in #marketing-assets. :rocket:
